communications.content: The invoice is EUR 1,950. We dispute EUR 250 because the keyboard navigation is missing. This remains unresolved.

expected_facts: EUR 1,950 is unpaid; an unresolved EUR 250 objection concerns missing keyboard navigation.

messages.text: I recorded a EUR 650 bank receipt. The navigation issue remains unresolved.

expected_facts: The unresolved EUR 250 objection concerns missing keyboard navigation.

messages.text: Correction: the EUR 650 included a duplicated EUR 150 entry. Actual cumulative received is EUR 500, and I corrected the record. No money was refunded.

expected_facts: The earlier EUR 650 entry was corrected to EUR 500 because EUR 150 was duplicated, not refunded.
EUR 1,450 remains; the unresolved EUR 250 keyboard-navigation objection remains.

messages.text: A further EUR 275 arrived. Actual paid total is now EUR 775; keep the tone friendly.

expected_facts: The earlier EUR 650 total was corrected to EUR 500 due to a duplicate, not a refund.
A later EUR 275 makes cumulative paid EUR 775 and outstanding EUR 1,175.
The original EUR 250 missing-keyboard-navigation objection is unresolved.

communications.content: We will pay the full USD 4,750 on December 3, 2026.

expected_facts: Client promised full USD 4,750 on December 3, 2026; no payment is recorded.

communications.content: We withdraw that full-payment promise. We can instead pay USD 2,375 on December 6, 2026 only if QA accepts the export. We cannot commit a date for the rest.

expected_facts: The December 3 full-payment promise was withdrawn.
Replacement promise is USD 2,375 on December 6, conditional on QA acceptance; the remaining balance has no promised date.

messages.text: I approved a follow-up for December 4, 2026. That is a reminder date, not a change to the client promise.

expected_facts: The approved follow-up is December 4, distinct from the conditional December 6 payment promise.
The original December 3 full-payment promise was withdrawn.

communications.content: Correction: our conditional USD 2,375 payment date is December 8, 2026 instead of December 6. QA acceptance is still required.

expected_facts: Original full-payment December 3 promise was withdrawn.
Conditional half-payment date was corrected from December 6 to December 8, 2026, still subject to QA acceptance.
